TPLF leader Debretsion Gebremichael said in a message aired on Tigrayan television on October 21 that his forces are still fighting federal troops, weeks after the army recaptured Mekelle. He claimed recent tactical victories and said Tigray would “remain a graveyard for its enemies,” claims Africanews did not independently verify.
